sentences.text: For the respondent: Ms. Leena Guleria, Deputy Advocate General.
Asi Santosh Kuamr, I.O. Police Station Indora, District Kangra, H.P. present with record.

The petitioner seeks regular bail in FIR No. 41 of 2022 dated 28.02.2022,
registered under Sections 376, 354, 511 and 506 of Indian Penal Code, at Police Station Indora,
District Kangra H.P.
2.
The respondent has filed the status report and also produced the record.
Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
After arguing for considerable time, learned counsel for the petitioner sought permission to withdraw the present petition.

The petition is accordingly dismissed as .
withdrawn.
The pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
